args.body: For BILINGUAL-TECHNICAL-AGENCY-PAID-PILOT, check the ProZ capture receipt and count this attempt against the existing three-capture allowance. Reuse equivalent findings if already committed. Treat index entries as leads. Spend a remaining capture only on an original current brief advertising a discrete paid EN/FR technical QA task with a concrete acceptance requirement. If one qualifies, run fictional passing and failing controls immediately against the exact requirement and preserve the source quotation, hash, command and actual output. Keep the sample usable privately if supplier or AI eligibility, submission authority or CAD collection is unresolved. Prepare a nonbinding operator response only where those terms support it. If the attempt produces no qualifying lead within the allowance, read back the actual coverage and close under a valid lease with a lesson specifying the original evidence that would reopen the route. No account creation, external contact, spending or deployment.
